content: Clinical trials investigating the comparative effectiveness of various medications, as endorsed by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), have demonstrated significant benefits on cardiovascular risk markers. Specifically, studies on agents such as empagliflozin, canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, liraglutide, and semaglutide have shown positive impacts in reducing cardiovascular risks. Furthermore, ongoing trials are actively assessing the effects of other therapeutic agents on outcomes such as atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) and renal disease.
